scenes.title: Biggest tire on a stock Land Cruiser Prado 90?
265/75R16
scenes.body: Doesn't rub unless the springs have sagged (IH8MUD).

scenes.title: 285/75R16
scenes.body: Rubs with or without a lift, on the upper control arm and a rear pinch weld that can be ground down (IH8MUD).

scenes.title: 255/85R16 (33 in)
scenes.body: Taller and lighter than a 285/75 and easier on the front end, but it needs a lift.

scenes.title: Every size, every lift.
scenes.body: Follow for a new truck every day.
